items.description: Close Phase 10 IN-02: delete the redundant function-local `from sif.database.database import Database  # noqa: PLC0415` inside vsearch_cmd (src/sif/cli/commands/search.py:630) — it duplicates the module-level import at line 20. Keep the other genuinely-local imports in that block (ValidationError, get_settings, EmbeddingManager, VectorSearcher are NOT imported at module level and must stay).
